About

I work where product direction, user behaviour, and technical complexity meet.

I started in software development and moved into product design, which helps me work closely with engineering teams and understand the technical consequences of product decisions. My practice combines product strategy, discovery, user research, coded prototyping, usability testing, information architecture, interaction design, design systems, product analytics, and cross-functional delivery. I have managed design teams across hiring, goals, performance reviews, development, compensation, and team composition. I am most effective as a hands-on Product Design Lead or Staff Product Designer: owning difficult product problems while building the process and team capability needed to deliver them.
